messages:
Alex M: Quick heads-up — APAC press briefing slot moved from 09:00 HKT to 15:00 HKT. Need confirmation that the quote for analyst brief and the embargo window are okay with legal. Draft quote here: https://docs.google.com/example-doc (please don't share externally). @Tara PR can you take point on sign-off?
Tara PR: On it. I'll ping Legal now and loop PM for product accuracy. Do we want a one-sentence version for APAC press vs a longer analyst quote?
Mike S: One-liner is safer for press. Draft suggestion: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency LLM inference that balances latency and unit cost." Thoughts?
Sasha: Can we call out private/VPC option in the analyst line — analysts always ask about regulated workloads. Maybe: "...across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments for regulated workloads."
Mike S: That reads fine. Slight tweak for flow: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
Tara PR: That works. I'll put both variants into the doc: PRESS_ONE_LINER and ANALYST_FULL. Also adding a short FAQ note for the brief (benchmarks, SLA, deployment modes).
press-bot: (bot) FYI — Embargo window currently set to Tue 05/10 15:00 UTC. Please complete all sign-offs by Mon 05/09 18:00 PT to avoid last-minute holds.
Alex M: Thanks — can we also get a quick factual check on the benchmark numbers? Link to benchmark methods: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/launch-v1. I'll highlight the specific lines in the doc.
Tara PR: Legal asked to avoid absolute SLA claims instead use "target" or "SLA-backed for Dedicated". I'll add the legal-friendly phrasing and tag you, Alex.
Mike S: Noted. Also adding an analyst-specific line re: cost: "reduces per-token cost via smart batching and KV caching" as an optional sentence — will add under ANALYST_FULL.
Sasha: Quick logistics — APAC analyst on PST conversion: 15:00 HKT is 00:00 PT next day. Confirming we have the right host + backup host. @Alex M do we have a secondible presenter?
Alex M: Yes — I'll list Sam Lee as backup presenter and include a 10-min pre-brief call 30m before start to test audio. Calendar invites updated after sign-off.
Tara PR: I'll run final fact-check pass and drop comments tonight. If anyone cannot sign by EOD Mon please DM. :raised_hands:
press-bot: (bot) Fact-check checklist reminder: 1) Product names match product catalog 2) Launch date locked 3) Benchmark methodology linked 4) Quotes approved by PR + Legal 5) Embargo time confirmed
Mike S: I'll be on standby to make wording tweaks in the doc.
Alex M: Perfect. If all good, I'll hit send to invites and embargo list after Tara posts final confirmation here. Appreciate the quick turn.
